release_notes: Whats new Meeting summaries now work fully offline. New

picker in Settings lets you choose between Claude (cloud) for top-quality summaries with your own API key, or Ollama (local) for 100% private summaries that never leave your Mac. Test connection button validates your Ollama setup instantly. Recording tools install on demand. When you enable Record Meetings without the required tools installed, OnAir now offers an

button right in Settings — no more silent failures or restart prompts. A notification and sound confirm when installation completes. Better progress visibility. The processing indicator now shows each step of the pipeline (1/3 Transcribing conversation, 2/3 Transcribing my voice, 3/3 Generating summary) with real-time updates every half-second. Improved summary quality. New anti-hallucination rules in the prompt prevent the AI from inventing participants, decisions, or arguments that werent in the meeting. Names, technical terms, and acronyms are now preserved exactly as transcribed. Settings cleanup - Meeting Recording is now its own dedicated section, separated from Actions - Shortcut dropdowns are clearly labeled Shortcut on Start and Shortcut on End - Summary Engine no longer defaults silently — you must explicitly choose Claude or Ollama - Validation at save: clear error messages if API key or summary engine are missing Under the hood - Default cooldown reduced from 5s to 3s for new installations - New transcription_segment_minutes config option (default: 5) controls Whisper segmentation - Configuration changes take effect immediately without app restart
